test.name: A same-named man the search rules out is recorded as a namesake, and the untied links it warns about go to person-evidence
test.description: Executing pli_006 (a Schuylkill County probate search, 1870-1890, for Thomas Flynn's estate), record_search returns only the estate file of a different Patrick Flynn: born about 1838, died 14 May 1882. The subject, Patrick Flynn (I1), died 12 March 1908, so the estate cannot be his. The skill must record that man as a namesakes row on I1 (Step 6b). research_append then warns that two of I1's links (pe_004, pe_005) stand with nothing in their records tying them to him; search-records cannot lower or tie them, so its return must hand both to person-evidence. Issue #3363, PR 2.

judge_context: Tool Arguments: score 3 if record_search was called with projectPath and parameters appropriate to a Flynn probate search in Schuylkill County for 1870-1890. The search is for Thomas Flynn's estate, so subjectId I2 (Thomas) is right and leaving subjectId out is acceptable; do not require subjectId I1. Score 2 only if record_search was skipped or had clearly wrong arguments. Do NOT expect a separate rank_search_matches call.

CORE (Correctness): the only result is the estate of a Patrick Flynn who died 14 May 1882. The subject died 12 March 1908, so this is a different same-named man. The skill must not adopt the record as the subject's, must not offer it for extraction, and must say plainly it is someone else.

Namesake row: having ruled that man out, the skill records him as a namesakes row on I1 (one research_append call, section namesakes, after the plan item status update), listing his recordId and the search's log id, with the ground (died 1882) as notes. Recording him does not adopt him and is not extraction; do not mark it down as either.

Hand-back: the namesakes write returns a warning that links pe_004 and pe_005 to I1 stand with nothing in their records tying them to him. search-records cannot write person_evidence, so its return must carry a 'Hand-back: person-evidence' line naming both links. Trying to lower or tie them itself, or leaving them unmentioned, is the failure this test guards.
Do NOT require the skill to find Thomas Flynn's probate; it is not available in this scenario. The plan item stays in_progress. A negative or partial outcome on the probate target is honest.
record_read is stocked but OPTIONAL. Score neither path down.
